answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 16 epochs. Receipts are issued in comet, burned on slash in thread, and listed in vertex. That removes the yield an copycat would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Repeating the trick 40 times costs 9 separate deposits and 37 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
